10 PRINT "LOOP CHECK"
20 LET B% = 2
30 FOR I% = 3 TO 1 STEP -1
40 FOR J% = 1 TO B%
50 PRINT "ITEM"; I%; J%
60 LET B% = 1
70 NEXT
80 NEXT I%
90 FOR K% = 1 TO 2 STEP -1
100 PRINT "UNREACHABLE"
110 NEXT K%
120 PRINT "FINAL COUNTERS"; I%; J%; K%
130 SYSTEM

10 PRINT "STOCK REORDER PLANNER"
20 INPUT "UNITS ON HAND"; H%
30 INPUT "TARGET UNITS"; T%
40 INPUT "UNITS PER CASE"; C%
50 IF H% < 0 THEN 190
60 IF T% < 0 THEN 190
70 IF C% <= 0 THEN 170
80 IF H% >= T% THEN 150 ELSE 90
90 LET N% = T% - H%
100 LET B% = N% \ C%
110 IF N% MOD C% = 0 THEN 130
120 LET B% = B% + 1
130 PRINT "CASES TO ORDER:"; B%
140 GOTO 200
150 PRINT "NO ORDER NEEDED"
160 GOTO 200
170 PRINT "CASE SIZE MUST BE POSITIVE"
180 GOTO 200
190 PRINT "UNIT COUNTS MUST BE NONNEGATIVE"
200 SYSTEM

10 PRINT "GREATEST COMMON DIVISOR"
20 INPUT "FIRST VALUE"; A%
30 INPUT "SECOND VALUE"; B%
40 IF A% < 0 THEN 90
50 IF B% < 0 THEN 90
60 GOSUB 200
70 PRINT "COMMON DIVISOR:"; A%
80 GOTO 400
90 PRINT "ENTER NONNEGATIVE VALUES"
100 GOTO 400
200 IF B% = 0 THEN 250
210 GOSUB 300
220 LET A% = B%
230 LET B% = R%
240 GOTO 200
250 RETURN
300 LET R% = A% MOD B%
310 RETURN
400 SYSTEM
